claim: At d004a20's module (git archive d004a20; unchanged at this commit), applied to pac-staging: the plan straight after the apply is not empty -- AWS stores rds.force_ssl with apply method pending-reboot and fills in the GitHub OIDC provider's thumbprint, so every later plan would show two in-place changes that are not changes

argv: import json,subprocess,sys; p=subprocess.run(sys.argv[1:],capture_output=True,text=True); m=[json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("{")]; c=[x["change"]["resource"]["addr"]+" "+x["change"]["action"] for x in m if x.get("type")=="planned_change"]; s=[x["@message"] for x in m if x.get("type")=="change_summary"]; print("; ".join(s+c) or "plan failed: exit %d" % p.returncode); sys.exit(p.returncode)

outcome.summary: Plan: 0 to add, 2 to change, 0 to destroy.; aws_iam_openid_connect_provider.github[0] update; aws_db_parameter_group.this update
